data.review_body:
★☆☆☆☆

I am extremely disappointed with my experience.

I placed order GSH17V39B000XJ5, but when my package arrived, five items were missing: four Musera sportswear items and one Flora Moment pink and white blanket.

I contacted customer support immediately and provided all the requested information. Instead of resolving the issue, I received repetitive responses and no real solution. I paid for products that I never received, yet SHEIN has refused to issue a refund or adequately investigate what happened.

Because of the lack of assistance, I have already filed a dispute with my bank for the missing items. I will also proceed with a formal complaint through the consumer protection authorities.

I have been a SHEIN customer before, but this experience has completely destroyed my trust in the company. If your package arrives incomplete, don’t expect customer service to take responsibility.

I hope SHEIN reviews my case and finally refunds the items I paid for but never received.


-SHEIN replied to my Trustpilot review saying they needed 24 hours to investigate and asked me to check the app for the resolution.

I did exactly that. The “resolution” in the app was simply that their internal investigation concluded that all the missing items were packed and shipped correctly, so they refused to take responsibility and told me to check the package again or contact the courier.

This is completely unacceptable.

Five items were NOT inside the package when I opened it. They did not fall out, they were not misplaced, and I have already checked everything multiple times.

Instead of providing evidence or offering a real solution, SHEIN simply repeated that their warehouse says everything was shipped, which does not prove that I actually received those items.

So please don’t tell me this case is “being resolved.” It has already been answered, and the answer was to deny my claim without solving anything.

I have already opened a dispute with my bank for the missing items and I will also file a complaint with the consumer protection authorities. I will continue updating this review until this issue is resolved properly.

This has been one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever had. Buyers should know that if items are missing from their package, SHEIN may simply claim that everything was shipped and leave you without a refund or replacement.

data.review_body:
I am very disappointed in Shein. For years I have purchased goods from them, and unlike all the horror stories, never got incorrect orders, or any other problems. Until my last order. 
I had ordered a large cross silicone mold to make 50 crosses for a wedding, and I recieved a small, different shaped, much cheaper mold. 
My problem lies in that their site is very user-unfriendly when it comes to this type of problem. Returning the smaller mold will cost me a fortune in shipping fees. Getting someone to attend to this is proving to be impossible, as their automated response bot does not have the correct option, and trying to get through to a human is not an option. I have sent 3 messages to their customer services, all to no avail.
 I am under a time constraint here, and am now forced to purchase the mold from the "other" site! 
Do better, Shein!!
data.review_headline: I am very disappointed in Shein

data.review_body: I've had a great experience shopping with SHEIN. The website is easy to use, there are so many styles to choose from, and the prices are very affordable. My order arrived on time, and everything was well packaged. The clothes matched the descriptions and fit better than I expected. I also liked being able to track my order throughout the delivery process. Overall, I'm very satisfied with my purchase and will definitely shop with SHEIN again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for trendy fashion at reasonable prices!
data.review_headline: I've had a great experience shopping…
